name: baseline-fairness

evidence.command_or_count: 8 verified / 9 attempted sources; 20 tool calls (bound 35); 0 live model calls

summarisation-based compaction for any named harness

key_findings: Aider all_messages() order = system + examples + readonly_files + repo + done + chat_files + cur + reminder; add_cache_control_headers() sets ephemeral breakpoints on examples/system, repo/readonly_files, chat_files
Aider docs: caches system prompt, read-only files, repository map, editable files; Anthropic default TTL 5 min; --cache-keepalive-pings to keep warm
SWE-agent LastNObservations docstring: 'will break prompt caching (as the history of every query will change every time due to the elided observations)'; polling param 'useful for caching'
OpenAI docs: 'Cache reuse requires the entire rendered prefix to match'; tools changes include ordering; parallel_tool_calls also affects prefix
LangGraph: model.invoke(state['messages']) with checkpointer; append-only state, compaction is an added node not a default
Prompt Cache (MLSys 2024): prompt modules + schema for positional accuracy; 8x GPU / 60x CPU TTFT
arXiv 2606.11869: precondition (P1) 'framed as tools, then system, then messages under prompt-caching'

recommended_baseline: static prefix + append-only history (a), with mandatory second arm static prefix + periodic compaction (b), and dynamic-state-in-prefix (c) only as a labelled sensitivity bound

static_segments: S2 tool definitions incl. deterministic ordering
baseline_spec.append_only: H = prior (role, content) deltas, never rewritten/re-ordered/re-summarised between compaction events
baseline_spec.volatile_location: D_t = the current turn's delta (cwd, date/time, step index, token counters, session id, model name, env snapshot, last tool result, mode)
fairness_controls: byte-identical re-serialisation from frozen buffer (whitespace/key order/float format are prefix)
explicit cache_control breakpoints at end of S3 and end of previous delta
equal information: same token multiset in both arms, only placement differs
identical TTL and keepalive policy (5-minute default; keepalive pings)
compaction recorded as a forced cache miss, never averaged away
same session lengths; report per-turn cache-hit tokens plus aggregate

strawman_risk: Reviewer: no real agent rewrites its system prompt every turn — Aider ships a deliberately cache-optimal prefix and keepalive, so a dynamic-prefix comparator is a fiction and any gain is the distance to a strawman. Answer sentence: the comparator is the incumbent's own cache-optimal renderer (fixed chunk order + cache_control breakpoints + keepalive), so the incumbent is granted every stability trick it ships and the only variable moved is where post-prefix state lives.

nearest_prior_art: arXiv:2311.04934 Prompt Cache (MLSys 2024) — stable-prefix module reuse + schema for positional accuracy; high threat to the idea, not the measurement
arXiv:2606.11869 Agents All the Way Down (Jun 2026) — states ordering 'tools, then system, then messages under prompt-caching' as a build precondition
Aider and SWE-agent source comments — practitioners already reason about cache invalidation
novelty_check.required_scoping: claim only the first controlled renderer-level measurement of cacheable-prefix preservation against the incumbent's own cache-optimal layout at equal information; do NOT claim stable-prefix-first as novel, do NOT claim harnesses rewrite system prompts every turn, do NOT claim compaction is universal

next_unit_hint: Implement the baseline renderer exactly as §2.1 (frozen S1-S3 byte buffer, append-only H, volatile state only in D_t, cache_control at S3-end and previous-delta-end, same keepalive/TTL as the pointer arm). Run arm (a) as headline, (b) as second arm with compaction counted as a forced miss, (c) only as sensitivity. Do not add an OpenHands or Cline row to the paper until a source is fetched.
